Applyer test job site

Stable local fixtures for exercising application filling, verification challenges, redirects, and failures.

  • Fillable application Recognized profile fields. Expected result: Filled.
  • Resolvable verification challenge Pauses first, then reveals a fillable form when resolved. Expected result: verification notification, then Filled.
  • Persistent verification challenge Cannot be resolved on-page. Use Applyer's Cancel action to exercise the Failed path.
  • Partially supported application Includes standard and custom questions. Expected result: Filled with skipped fields.
  • Unsupported application No recognized fields. Expected result: Failed with form_not_supported.
  • Redirect to application HTTP 302 to the fillable fixture.
  • Server error Returns an intentional HTTP 500 response.
